description: This script generates and compiles an Android native test APK bundle, including copying template files, replacing placeholders, copying native libraries, and building with ant.

classes.name: NativeTestApkGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating the source tree for a native test APK, including copying files, replacing strings, copying libraries, and building the APK.

methods.name: _LibraryRoot
methods.description: Returns a root name for the shared library, used for substitution in APK files.

methods.name: _CopyTemplateFilesAndClearDir
methods.description: Copies necessary template files to the output directory, clearing existing files.

methods.name: _ReplaceStrings
methods.description: Replaces 'replaceme' placeholders in files with the library root name.

methods.name: _CopyLibrary
methods.description: Copies the native shared library into the APK source tree, stripping it if necessary.

methods.name: CreateBundle
methods.description: Creates the APK source bundle by copying files, replacing strings, and copying the library.

methods.name: Compile
methods.description: Builds the APK using ant with specified arguments.
